remarks: Location, location, location! Enjoy affordable living just steps from Cove Island Park in this spacious first-floor (stairs) two-bedroom, one-bath apartment. The home features a large eat-in kitchen, a sizable light-filled living room, and plenty of storage with multiple closets throughout. Two well apportioned bedrooms! Additional highlights include in-building laundry and off-street parking for two cars. A fantastic opportunity to live close to the beach, park, and appreciate all the facilities that the area has to offer: Life is sweet!!
